description: The process identity check UI provides correct VoiceOver accessibility labels so screen reader users can understand the ambiguous state and available actions.
assertions: banner has accessibilityLabel describing ambiguous process identity
each resolution action button has unique accessibilityLabel
accessibilityHint describes outcome of each action
focused element reads state as 'held' or 'ambiguous', not 'loading'
VoiceOver can navigate all interactive elements without trap
